title: Cross-test's era-1 'pinned explicitly' claim is a dead continue — no assertion pins the era-1 gate bar anywhere
detail: Comment and PR body claim the era-1 split is pinned, but nothing asserts it. If the predicate stopped naming era-1 narrows legacy (the 1→2 gate bar), no test fails — the documented split drifts silently.
recommended_fix: Replace the no-op continue with a real pin: at era 1 assert legacy==true for below-newest tiers and decayed==false (e.g. expectf(t, era_pipe_is_legacy(cat, 1, na)) plus the existing capacity pin).
